Thanks for the report and the repro.

I checked `packages/browser/src/node/commands/screenshotMatcher/index.ts` (lines ~65-101). When `updateSnapshot === 'all'` (which is what `--update` sets), the matcher returns early. It writes the new stable screenshot to the reference path and returns `pass: true` (case #03). This happens before the comparator at line 112 runs. So an existing reference that would pass the comparison is still overwritten. That matches what you describe.

I couldn't find an earlier issue about this. The docs in `docs/guide/browser/visual-regression-testing.md` describe `--update` only as a way to refresh references after intentional UI changes. They don't say whether passing screenshots should be rewritten.

The early return looks deliberate, so the maintainers will need to decide whether to change it. One option is to run the comparator when a reference exists and only write if it fails. That would be closer to how `toMatchSnapshot` behaves with `-u`.

I haven't run your repro. I'm not promising a change or a timeline.
